extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store listing.

extDesc.message: Save web copies into YouBoard and paste your history into any input field. Needs the YouBoard desktop app.
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in the browser and the store listing.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search what you copied on web pages…

emptyHint.message: Nothing here yet. Copy some text on a page with Ctrl+C, or use the button below to read the clipboard.

panelHint.message: Click an item = copy to clipboard; double-click = insert into the input field on the current page. Talks only to YouBoard on 127.0.0.1 — nothing is uploaded.

noInputOnPage.message: No input field on this page

optConnHeading.message: Connect to YouBoard on this machine

optConnNote.message: Open the YouBoard desktop app → Settings → Browser extension → "Copy connection info", then paste that single line below. It only talks to 127.0.0.1 on this machine — no server involved.

optTokenPlaceholder.message: The token shown in YouBoard settings

optCaptureLabel.message: Capture copies on web pages (Ctrl+C / cut)

optSyncLabel.message: Also write into the desktop YouBoard (off = browser only)

optMaxLabel.message: How many items to keep in the browser

optIgnoreLabel.message: Sites to skip (one per line, can be empty)

optPrivacyNote.message: The extension never sends data to a remote server: captured content stays in your browser, or goes to YouBoard on 127.0.0.1. The clipboard-read permission is requested only when you click "Read clipboard & save".

optParseFailed.message: Could not parse that connection line

optConnectFailedHint.message: make sure the desktop app is running and the token matches
